title: Create Unique Card
description: Add absolute wireless security to Create's Redstone Links. Introduces the "Unique Card" encrypted with a one-of-a-kind UUID to prevent any channel cross-wiring.
body:
# Create Unique Card

**Create: Unique Card** is a lightweight, standalone add-on for the Create mod that flawlessly solves channel cross-wiring and frequency shortages in Redstone Links.

No more stressing over the limits of 2-slot item combinations or worrying about signal interference in massive factories and multiplayer servers. This mod introduces the "Unique Card" to deliver absolute wireless security.

---

## 🛠️ Features

- **One-of-a-Kind Frequencies (UUID)**
  Right-clicking an un-tuned card imprints a completely unique encryption frequency (UUID) that will never duplicate across your world.
- **1-to-1 Dedicated Secure Lines**
  Simply place the card into one (or both) of the Redstone Link's frequency slots to instantly establish a dedicated network completely immune to cross-wiring with any other item combinations.

---

## 💡 Perfect For

- Players whose massive automation factories have pushed standard frequency management to its limits.
- Server administrators and players looking to completely secure their wireless networks from neighbors.
